steps.prompt:
Edit the provided image as a localized cleanup of an existing Gen III GBA Pokemon BACK battle sprite named Nimbatu, an aquatic teal bird with blue-and-gold crest. This is an EDIT TARGET, not inspiration for a redesign. The image is an exact 16x nearest-neighbor enlargement of a 64x64 logical pixel canvas. Keep exactly this canvas, creature size, position, silhouette, battle camera/crop, anatomical features, crest feather count/shape, gold stripes, beak, cheek marking, dark navy collar, gold shoulder V, folded wings and palette. Transparent background, no floor shadow, scenery, labels or grid lines.

Repair ONLY the head plumage, native coordinates x=30..53, y=21..39 (display x=480..863,y=336..639). Its present left/lower rim has several parallel dark blue rows wrapped around a flat teal center, making a thick stroke and ring shading. On the lit upper-left head edge, keep a deliberate SINGLE logical-pixel dark outer contour and replace redundant inner dark-blue lanes with teal plumage. Make the rounded head read as one volume with light from above/upper left: broad teal lit/base area and one coherent compact blue form-shadow cluster primarily on the lower/right underside above the collar. Retain a supported small overlap shadow where the crest attaches. No concentric shading rings, no repeated shadow strips tracing the same staircase, no extra bright rim. Preserve the original outline path, head shape and cheek/beak transition. Do NOT add an eye to this rear-facing head. Do NOT thin or reshape the crest feathers, collar or wings; these are legitimate filled anatomy, not excess outline.

Use the same limited opaque palette with hard square clusters and a deliberate coherent pixel-run cadence on the FINAL 64x64 grid. Each source logical pixel is a uniform 16x16 display block. No soft painting, blur, mixed-resolution marks, translucent fringes or antialias halos. All pixels outside the named head region must remain exactly as the reference. Return the same complete 1024x1024 16x sprite with genuine transparency.
steps.export_policy: 31 selected head material pixels only; existing palette, contour, silhouette, crest, collar, cheek, beak and wings preserved.

steps.prompt:
Create the second animation frame by EDITING this exact existing Gen III GBA Nimbatu front sprite. The provided image is the EDIT TARGET, an exact 16x enlargement of a 64x64 logical grid. Return the SAME transparent square canvas, exact creature size, position, anatomy, pose and palette. This is a subtle wingtip flutter: change ONLY the outermost primary feather tips on the left and right wings by ONE or TWO logical pixels downwards. Edit native rectangles left x=2..12,y=15..30 and right x=51..62,y=15..30 (16 display pixels per logical pixel). Keep the wing roots, shoulders, head, crest, eye, gold chevrons, torso, tail, legs and FEET EXACTLY FIXED. No whole-body bob, crouch, scale change, translation, camera change or new details. Preserve the wide raised-wing silhouette and the original overall feather lengths and blue/gold/white markings. The wingtip change should be small but visibly distinct when alternated with this reference frame.

Every outer wing contour must remain a deliberate SINGLE logical-pixel dark line at the FINAL 64x64 grid; no swollen tips, doubled strokes, parallel two/three-pixel border lanes, or choppy isolated pixels. Native stepped curves and pointed feathers with coherent run cadence. Light from above/upper-left, preserve existing material/shadow roles and broad pale lower wing bands; blue feather interiors are legitimate filled areas. Do not replace the wing with rings of outline or concentric shading. Keep all silhouette pixels inside the 64x64 canvas with the existing one-pixel right margin. Hard flat square clusters on a known 64x64 logical grid, existing 13 opaque colors, no antialiasing, blur, soft gradients, translucent edge halo, labels, backdrop or painted ground shadow. Return only the complete edited sprite on genuine transparency, same composition.
steps.export_policy: Second frame derived from unchanged first frame. Only the two nominated outer wingtip rectangles imported; core body and feet remain identical to frame 0.
